title: Chapter 262: Millions Of Ambush Troops
content:
Chapter 262: Millions Of Ambush Troops

Wu Qing consumed a large number of resources again and hatched 500 three-star Zerg Queens.

These Zerg Queens can only be three-star for the time being. If you want to upgrade all of them to five-star, you may not be able to consume all the existing gas resources in the system, so you can only give up.

The ability of the Zerg Queen is very powerful, but the resources consumed are also very, very many.

The Zerg cannot rely on the Zerg Queen to conquer the world. The main force of the Zerg army is still other main combat arms. At this time, you have to make some choices.

To be honest, I have been using Yeguo Reading to read books and follow the updates recently. It can switch sources and has many reading tones. It can be used on Android and Apple.

Wu Qing hatched another batch of Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes for backup.

The Light Griffins of the Alien Human Race flew to the battlefield and rushed directly to the sky above the Zerg army to participate in the battle.

After this period of recovery, the 500 five-star Zerg Queens have restored their ability to lay eggs and attack. Of course, Wu Qing ordered the Zerg Queen to launch a spawning attack on the 500 Light Griffin Knights without saying a word.

The aliens really spared no expense this time. In addition to the 500 Light Griffin Knights attacked by the Zerg Queen, there were many Light Griffin Knights mixed in the entire group of Light Griffins.

They no longer attacked the Zerg Destroyers, but launched an indiscriminate attack on the Zerg army as soon as they entered the attack range!

Five-star light arrows shot into the Zerg army's defense line, and the Zerg cockroaches' defense and self-healing ability could not resist them, and casualties began to occur.

Many Zerg Hydralisks died directly under such a fierce attack and disappeared in light.

Seeing this, the Zerg puppies all hid underground.

The Light Griffin Knights of the aliens directly attacked the Zerg army's defense line, and soon opened a gap for the alien army that was attacking the Zerg army's defense line.

A large number of alien troops quickly rushed to the gap in the Zerg army's defense line!

In order to plug this gap, the Zerg army turned the firepower of a large number of Zerg destroyers to launch a fierce attack on the alien army outside the gap in the defense line.

A large number of alien army gathered in one area, and was wiped out under the attack of five-star Zerg destroyers.

Under the chain reaction, too much firepower of Zerg destroyers was occupied here, and the pressure on the alien army attacking from other directions was greatly reduced. They used various long-range arms to suppress the attack of the Zerg army and create favorable conditions for the melee arms to charge.

The aliens invested more and more troops, and there were many powerful arms participating in the battle, especially the large number of five-star arms like the Light Griffin Knights, and the Zerg army's defense line gradually had multiple gaps.

The number of casualties of the Zerg army continued to increase, and a large number of two-star arms were reduced.

If the previous Zerg army's defense line was just in danger, then the current Zerg army's defense line is full of holes!

"I don't know what cards the Zerg has left! If we don't use them now, we will have no chance!"

"The power invested by the aliens this time is too strong. We must destroy this Zerg army!"

"The evil gods in the evil god camp are most afraid of sacrificing their believers like the Zerg. The Zerg has challenged their bottom line, so the aliens are targeting the Zerg at all costs!"

"The Zerg's sacrificial ability is really powerful and magical! The evil god believers who were killed were not spared, and all were sacrificed cleanly! It's so clean! It makes people feel relieved! Haha!"

"Some races also have similar sacrificial abilities, but they generally dare not use them so openly, because they are afraid of being targeted by the evil gods in the evil god camp!"

"I admire the courage of the Zerg! I hope they can survive this disaster!"

"As long as we can win this battle, when the Zerg's subsequent forces are put in, it won't necessarily be the aliens who come to fight the Zerg!"

"Yes, the Zerg's only weakness is that their foundation here is too shallow, and they shouldn't be so eager to advance!"

"They also want to seize territory and build a foundation. I didn't expect that their actions are fast, and the aliens are not slow either!"

"The Zerg army can fight to this extent, which has demonstrated its strong strength. I hope that all major tribes can help them through this disaster!"

"If someone helps, the nature will be different!"

"It's better to not win than to fail!"

"..."

The perfect performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield has won the recognition of most of the observers of the local camp. Everyone hopes that the Zerg can win this difficult battle.

Create another miracle!

...

The pressure on the Zerg army is indeed great, but the gains are also huge. The system resources are growing rapidly!

Ten thousand five-star Zerg destroyers and forty thousand three-star and four-star Zerg destroyers, their attacks are very terrible.

A round of attack by the Zerg destroyers can wipe out tens of thousands of alien human troops, hundreds of thousands, and even hundreds of thousands of enemies!

This is because the alien human army consciously dispersed the attacking forces as much as possible, which greatly reduced the killing efficiency of the Zerg destroyers and failed to achieve the best killing effect.

There are too many enemy troops and they are distributed over a wide area. In addition, the Zerg destroyers are not perpetual motion machines. Each of their attacks has a certain interval, so the 50,000 Zerg destroyers are far from enough on this battlefield.

The situation faced by other Zerg troops is similar to that of Zerg destroyers. Except for a small number of five-star troops of the aliens, the Zerg army has an absolute advantage in average strength, but the alien army has too many troops.

"Now the time is almost right!"

"The aliens have already suffered such a huge loss. Even if we increase their troops, they probably won't be willing to fail!"

"It's a dilemma. I want to see how courageous the aliens are!"

Wu Qing also knew that if he waited any longer, the entire Zerg army's defense line might be broken through by the alien army.

The Zerg now increases its troops. As long as they don't make the aliens despair right from the start, the aliens, who have invested so much, will definitely not retreat easily.

As long as Wu Qing gives the aliens a little hope of victory, he can delay the troops that the aliens have invested now, and maybe even let the aliens continue to increase their investment.

At Wu Qing's command, something happened that shocked the observers of various forces in the local camp and the aliens!

Suddenly, countless Zerg puppies emerged from the ground in the 66th city and the surrounding areas!

Experienced observers knew at a glance that this was a force of tens of millions!

The Zerg puppies have the combat power equivalent to that of a one-star army. They came out of the underground and besieged the alien army around them that could not react in time!

The team combat cooperation of the Zerg puppies is extremely efficient. They will instantly formulate the best attack mode according to the enemy's situation.

They have brought the cooperation of the team tactics to the extreme, such as single strong killing when facing goblins, team siege when facing star-level soldiers, multi-level uninterrupted siege when facing strong people, etc.

The terrible killing machine of the Zerg puppies has set off a terrifying bloody wave in the alien army. Countless alien armies were slaughtered in an instant and disappeared in light.

"What's going on! Am I seeing things?"

"Tens of millions of Zerg troops! Tens of millions of Zerg troops ambushed! How did they do it!"

"Miracle! It's really a miracle! We came here with the Zerg army! They actually ambushed so many troops here quietly!"

"How did the Zerg secretly transport such a large number of troops here!?"

"Space transmission channel! It must have been transmitted through space! I finally understand! Why did the Zerg army keep dragging its feet and not quickly capture this city! It turns out that they are secretly building a space transmission channel!"

"Can a large space transmission channel be built so quickly? This is something that ordinary large tribes can't do!"

" The Zerg's background is really unfathomable! "

"Quickly capture this city, and you can also build a space transmission channel! The Zerg must have deliberately attracted the alien army to attack! So that's it! No wonder the Zerg army's previous operations seemed a bit unreasonable! "

"Haha! The aliens invested so many troops and suffered such heavy losses. Now facing the strong support of the Zerg, let's see how they choose! "

"The Zerg army has an aid channel, and now it's the turn of the aliens to be blind, haha!"

"..."

Facing the miracle created by the Zerg, the observers of various forces in the local camp were amazed and happy. The observers who should have been very calm had been mobilized by the Zerg's battlefield performance.

Moreover, this emotion was very strong!

They had never encountered an observation object like the Zerg before!

After the Zerg puppy appeared, the Zerg troops of various arms hidden underground in the Zerg army's defense position quickly came to the ground and entered the Zerg army's defense position with a large amount of space reserved.

As soon as the five hundred three-star Zerg destroyers appeared on the ground, they launched a spawning attack on the five-star soldiers of the alien race, such as the Light Griffin Knights, who were attacking the Zerg army.

The spawning attack of the three-star Zerg destroyers cannot cross two stars to kill the five-star enemies with one blow, but it can seriously interfere with the combat capability of the five-star enemies.

As long as the five-star soldiers of the alien army are hit by the self-destructing parasites, it is impossible to eliminate them in a short time, which means they have lost their combat effectiveness.

This is a disguised way to eliminate the five-star soldiers in the alien army.

A large number of Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg Cockroaches, Zerg Destroyers and Zerg Stealth Spiders entered the Zerg army's defense line in an orderly manner, completely making up for the problem of insufficient Zerg army.

These newly hatched soldiers are all one-star strength, and their actual combat power is close to two stars. Their individual combat power is much stronger than the star soldiers of the alien race.

Their participation in the battle quickly cleared out the alien air forces, as well as the alien offensive forces in the battle zone in front of the Zerg army's defense line, which the Zerg puppies had deliberately avoided!
